title: Sustainable Use of Transboundary Water Resources and Water Security Management (WATER SUM)
image_alt: Sustainable Use of Transboundary Water Resources and Water Security Management (WATER SUM)
body: As Project Director, I provided overall quality control of the project, supervision of the Project Manager and team members, monitoring of the progress of the project activities and coordination of information flow between the project team, beneficiaries and the donor. Water SUM project addresses water-related challenges and promotes regional cooperation in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) through two project components: Water Resources Management Good Practices and Knowledge Transfer (WATER POrT); and Water Security in Local Communities (WaSe).
